title: Plugging the Leaks: Reassessing the UK General Anti-Abuse Rule in Light of Practical and Doctrinal Failures
affiliations: Independent Legal Researcher

detail.title: Plugging the Leaks: Reassessing the UK General Anti-Abuse Rule in Light of Practical and Doctrinal Failures
detail.abstract: This paper offers a doctrinal and policy reassessment of the United Kingdom’s General Anti-Abuse Rule (GAAR), introduced by Schedule 43 to the Finance Act 2013. Conceived as a principled legislative safeguard against abusive tax avoidance, GAAR has failed to deliver either certainty or deterrence. Its central test—the “double reasonableness” standard—is circular and legally indeterminate. Its institutional machinery—the GAAR Advisory Panel—produces non-binding opinions insulated from judicial scrutiny. Its enforcement record is minimal, opaque, and doctrinally unproductive. Moreover, GAAR’s relationship with adjacent regimes—DOTAS, TAARs, and OECD BEPS measures—remains undefined, creating duplication and systemic incoherence. Through comparative analysis with Australia and Canada, where general anti-avoidance rules have generated more structured jurisprudence, the paper argues that the UK GAAR suffers from design flaws that undermine constitutional principles of legality, certainty, and proportionality. It proposes statutory reform to replace the double reasonableness test with structured indicia of abuse, to transform the Advisory Panel into an adjudicative body, to impose transparency obligations on HMRC, and to integrate GAAR coherently with specific anti-avoidance regimes. The argument is that GAAR should not be abandoned but rebuilt: reconstituted into a credible, principled, and proportionate safeguard that restores coherence to the UK’s anti-avoidance framework.

AI.tldr: 本文对英国《一般反滥用规则》（GAAR）进行了教义和政策重新评估，认为GAAR存在设计缺陷，未能实现确定性和威慑力。通过比较澳大利亚和加拿大的经验，提出用结构化滥用指标替代"双重合理性"标准、将咨询小组转变为裁决机构等改革建议。

AI.motivation: GAAR作为原则性立法保障措施，在实践中既未提供确定性也缺乏威慑力，其制度设计存在根本性缺陷，需要系统性改革。

AI.findings: GAAR的"双重合理性"标准存在循环性和法律不确定性；咨询小组意见无约束力且不受司法审查；执法记录稀少且不透明；与相邻制度关系未定义导致重复和系统性不连贯
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了GAAR制度设计的理论框架，强调宪法原则在反避税制度中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体改革方案：用结构化滥用指标替代现有标准、建立裁决机构、加强透明度义务、实现制度整合

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships with any other people or organizations that may have, or could be perceived to have, influenced this study.

declarations.funderStatement: Funding: None. This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This comprehensive study addresses the half dozen hues of decentralization and local government empowerment, and the dichotomous relationship between constitutional provided for reality. Notwithstanding extensive formal decentralization policies introduced since the 1970s, local authorities still encounter systemic challenges including very limited financial autonomy, widespread political intervention and centralized control structures that fundamentally contradict the pursuit of democratic governance goals. The study examines institutional structures, fiscal relationships and governance performance to identify eight key reform areas-financial autonomy through creative revenue options; constitutionally defined roles of levels of government; democratic balance at local level institutions; simplified path for availing the development fund transfers; strategic introduction of technologies for improved urban service delivery or beyond social registry formation strategy that facilitates an integrated approach towards anti-poverty fighting-spirit on an strong transformative mode Urban Governance Reform transformational capacity building 4.2. Bangladesh's urban population in 2023 will rise to 40.47%, and it is expected that projected demographic models predict this figure to increase to 56% by the year 2050, therefore, effectively functioning local governance is an imperative for attaining Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and tackling the complex manifestations of poverty, vulnerability and social exclusion that are essentially localized. Empirical evidence suggests that real devolution of power to local governments requires systemic reform that tackles fundamental structural bottlenecks and, at the same time, invests in strong institutional capacity for responsive, accountable and participatory governance in response to community driven needs rather than political ones.

reference: Florida International University Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming; Rev. Litig., 45 (2025): 1; Review of Litigation (University of Texas), 45 (2025)
title: The Universal Lexicon: Generative AI Chatbots and Fair Use of Works in a Training Corpus
affiliations: Florida International University College of Law

detail.title: The Universal Lexicon: Generative AI Chatbots and Fair Use of Works in a Training Corpus

publicationDetails.detailsText: Florida International University Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Florida International University College of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
For centuries, research publications, encyclopedias, and lexicons have helped advance knowledge by drawing freely on expressive works, without seeking licenses for most of what they reference or “use.” Today, that longstanding practice is under new and intense scrutiny.  One pressing question is whether chatbots powered artificial intelligence (AI) should be treated differently.  Major copyright holders, including The New York Times, leading authors, and powerful music rights organizations, have filed lawsuits against companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.  They argue that the training and output of AI systems infringe the exclusive rights of copyright holders, principally the rights of reproduction, distribution, and preparation of derivative works.  The Supreme Court’s decision in Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts v. Goldsmith has raised the stakes in this copyright controversy by narrowing the meaning of transformative fair use and casting fresh doubt on whether copyright law still permits the creation of generative AI (gen-AI) models as modern lexicons of knowledge.

This article examines prior copyright claims against lexicons, scholarly works, and directories, among other technologies and creations, and explains why the right to release a universal lexicon of culture and thought must be defended.  At stake is not simply a technical question of doctrine, but the future of tools that help society organize and expand human knowledge.  First, the purpose of a lexicon or grand encyclopedia differs fundamentally from that of novels, songs, or other creative works, or even individual news articles, press releases, or webpages.  Courts have long recognized that reference works, like news reporting and scholarship, serve purposes that fair use protects, precisely because they promote the progress of knowledge rather than mere entertainment.  Second, the amount and substantiality of what is used in AI outputs can often be negligible.  Any fragment that may appear in output is generally tiny, both in absolute terms and as a proportion of the original work, and rarely, if ever, recreates the expressive heart of that work.  Third, efforts to prohibit research-based creativity by invoking hypothetical licensing markets threaten to dismantle fair use itself.  They invite a circular reasoning process in which any unpaid use is treated as illegal harm simply because it could have been licensed.  Some courts have rightly rejected this logic and have insisted that fair use requires rightsholders to demonstrate a real and direct connection between a specific use and actual loss, whether in sales, profits, or other market value. Mere claims that a license might have been sold are not enough.  What follows is an analysis of why generative AI models fit within the longstanding protections of fair use, and how courts should apply similarity-related principles of fact, genre, and research to defend the creation of these modern lexicons.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI生成模型是否应受合理使用原则保护，分析了传统知识工具（如词典、百科全书）与AI系统的相似性，主张AI训练和输出应被视为合理使用，以促进知识进步。

title: Role of temporal variation of spatial inequality in epidemiology
affiliations: Aalto University - School of Science and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Role of temporal variation of spatial inequality in epidemiology
detail.abstract: Infectious diseases change epicenters with time. This leads to a temporal variation of spatial inequality in the region-wise number of infected and dead people. We can obtain many important facts related to infectious disease simply by studying the pattern of temporal variation. This is the main purpose of the present study. As this requires, plenty of data over a considerable time span, here we have considered the state-wise number of infected and dead people due to COVID-19 to study temporal variation spatial inequalities. In India COVID-19 started to spread around March, 2020 and reached final endemic equilibrium around July 2022. So, we have considered this duration of time to study how spatial inequality in state-wise number of infected and dead people evolved. This study hints the possible realistic maxima of inequality in case of an unrestricted social issue like a new type of infectious disease like COVID-19. Here we have also found that temporal variation of spatial inequality helps to predict when overall infection rate or death rate of a country will rise or fall. It also indicates how the equality indexes under study are interrelated with each other. We have also compared the outcomes of these study with other social issues like inequality in citation of published paper by various Nobel laureates of different fields and found that the outcomes are similar. This further enhances the importance of the outcomes of the study.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析印度COVID-19疫情期间各州感染和死亡人数的空间不平等性随时间变化模式，揭示了传染病传播中空间不平等性的演化规律及其对整体感染/死亡率预测的价值，并将结果与其他社会不平等现象进行对比验证。

AI.findings: 发现了空间不平等性的现实最大值，时空变异有助于预测整体感染/死亡率变化，不同平等指数之间存在相互关联，且与诺贝尔奖得主论文引用不平等现象具有相似模式

title: An Honest Assessment of Realized Volatility Forecasting with Feed-Forward Neural Networks and Traditional Models: Evidence from International Equity Markets under Normal Conditions and the COVID-19 Crisis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: An Honest Assessment of Realized Volatility Forecasting with Feed-Forward Neural Networks and Traditional Models: Evidence from International Equity Markets under Normal Conditions and the COVID-19 Crisis
detail.abstract: This thesis provides a comprehensive evaluation of machine learning models versus traditional econometric approaches for realized volatility forecasting using high-frequency data from eight major stock indices (AEX, FTSE 100, S&P 500, Dow Jones, DAX, CAC 40, FTSE MIB, IBEX 35) spanning 2000-2021. Four feed-forward neural networks of varying architectures are compared against the HAR-RV model (Corsi, 2009) and GARCH(1,1), with their performance evaluated under three loss functions: MSE, MAE, and QLIKE. The analysis yields three key findings. First, the parsimonious HAR-RV model demonstrates unambiguous superiority across all evaluation metrics, significantly outperforming both the best-performing FFNN architecture (16 × 8 × 4) and GARCH(1,1). Second, FFNN performance exhibits a nonmonotonic relationship with architectural complexity. The moderate-depth network (16×8×4) approaches but never surpasses HAR-RV's performance, while deeper architectures show diminishing returns. Third, model rankings remain remarkably stable during the COVID-19 crisis. HAR-RV maintains its dominance and demonstrates superior crisis robustness. These findings contrast with recent literature, particularly Christensen et al. (2023). It is concluded that the reported advantages of FFNNs in volatility forecasting are contingent on specific implementation choices, including feature engineering, ensemble methods, regularization techniques, and market regimes.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了机器学习模型与传统计量经济学方法在8个主要股指高频数据波动率预测中的表现，发现简洁的HAR-RV模型在所有评估指标上均优于前馈神经网络和GARCH(1,1)模型。
AI.research_question: 机器学习模型是否比传统计量经济学方法在实现波动率预测方面表现更优？
AI.motivation: 近期文献（如Christensen et al., 2023）报告了前馈神经网络在波动率预测中的优势，但本研究旨在验证这些发现是否具有普遍性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Corsi（2009）的HAR-RV模型、GARCH(1,1)模型和前馈神经网络理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2000-2021年8个主要股指的高频数据，比较4种不同架构的前馈神经网络与HAR-RV和GARCH(1,1)模型，采用MSE、MAE和QLIKE三种损失函数进行评估。
AI.findings: 1）HAR-RV模型在所有指标上均显著优于最佳FFNN架构和GARCH(1,1)；2）FFNN性能与架构复杂度呈非单调关系；3）COVID-19危机期间模型排名保持稳定，HAR-RV表现出更强的危机稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了近期关于FFNN在波动率预测中优势的文献，指出这些优势取决于特定的实现选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了关于波动率预测模型选择的实证依据，建议在特定条件下优先考虑简洁的HAR-RV模型而非复杂的神经网络。

title: Strategic vs Financial Buyers in AI M&A : A Behavioural and Valuation Comparison
affiliations: Arkstons Investments Limited, affiliation not provided to SSRN, , , , St Anne's College, the University of Oxford and

detail.title: Strategic vs Financial Buyers in AI M&A : A Behavioural and Valuation Comparison
detail.abstract:
This white paper examines how strategic and financial buyers approach artificial intelligence (AI) mergers and acquisitions (M&A), highlighting the behavioural, valuation, and outcome differences between the two. Strategics pay higher revenue multiples for distribution and moat fit; financial sponsors pay for clean unit economics and near-term cash generation; process design can swing outcomes.
The rise in AI-related M&A has reshaped technology dealmaking, with both corporate and private equity firms aggressively pursuing AI assets to capture value from the rapid adoption of machine learning, data infrastructure, and automation. Global AI transactions have accelerated since 2018, reflecting both strategic imperatives and financial opportunities.
As AI deal activity has surged, the motivations and methods of acquirers diverge sharply. Strategic buyers seek acquisitions to deepen their ecosystems, secure proprietary datasets, and gain scarce AI talent, while financial buyers concentrate on operational scalability, recurring revenues, and disciplined exit planning.
This paper provides an evidence-based comparison of buyer behaviour, valuation multiples, and post-deal trajectories. By analysing 30–50 AI-focused transactions between 2018 and 2024, the paper show that strategic buyers frequently pay significant premiums and justify them through synergies, integration, and competitive defence. Financial buyers, in contrast, deploy leverage to target cash-generative SaaS and cybersecurity firms, achieving mid-term returns with less emphasis on innovation continuity.
For founders, investors, and advisors, these insights clarify the trade-offs inherent in different buyer types and provide a practical framework for evaluating AI M&A. Strategic acquirers may accelerate growth and provide premium valuations but reduce independence, while financial buyers often preserve management continuity and offer structured liquidity at the cost of lower upfront multiples.

detail.title: Long-term Investing in Hong Kong: Developments and Opportunities in a Digital Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper AR No. 2/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The report, building upon the HKIMR's prior research on demographic changes and long-term asset markets, provides a comprehensive and updated analysis of Hong Kong's long-term investing landscape and opportunities within the context of an evolving digital economy. The report covers two surveys that were commissioned by the HKIMR. The first survey, carried out in collaboration with the Investor and Financial Education Council, explored Hong Kong residents' long-term investment decisions. The second survey, administered in collaboration with a consulting firm, focused on local market participants to gain insight into their perspectives on product development, distribution strategies, and the adoption of technology. 

The study highlights that while Hong Kong residents exhibit a strong foundation for basic financial knowledge, there is a need for greater awareness of specific financial products, particularly those related to long-term investing and financial planning. As for products, Hong Kong already possesses a diverse suite of globally competitive accumulation products. However, 67 per cent of the surveyed market participants saw the crucial need to increase the supply of decumulation product options to accommodate their customers' demand for long-term financial planning.
      
The study also reflects that digital adoption among both survey groups is high. In the study, 72 per cent of surveyed residents reported using digital financial services in the past year, and about 70 per cent of the surveyed market participants reported they are currently adopting or plan to adopt mobile and web platforms to distribute long-term financial products. Based on these survey findings, the study suggests some considerations to foster a healthy long-term investment ecosystem in Hong Kong. Among those, embracing frontier technologies is key to drive innovative product and services, increase cost efficiency, and further enhance product distribution to support more effective long-term investing and financial planning.

AI.motivation: 基于香港金融研究所之前关于人口变化和长期资产市场的研究，需要更新分析香港长期投资格局，特别是在数字经济快速发展的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长期投资理论、金融产品生命周期理论、数字技术采纳理论
AI.method: 采用两项调查方法：第一项与投资者及金融教育委员会合作调查香港居民的长期投资决策；第二项与咨询公司合作调查市场参与者对产品开发、分销策略和技术采纳的看法。
AI.findings: 1. 香港居民具备基础金融知识，但对长期投资产品了解不足；2. 香港拥有多样化的全球竞争力积累产品，但67%的市场参与者认为需要增加退休产品供应；3. 数字化采用率高：72%居民使用数字金融服务，70%市场参与者采用或计划采用移动和网络平台分销长期金融产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了长期投资生态系统理论，特别是在数字经济背景下的应用；提供了金融产品生命周期理论在退休产品需求方面的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为香港长期投资生态系统发展提供政策建议；强调前沿技术在推动创新产品、提高成本效率和增强产品分销方面的重要性；为金融机构产品开发和服务创新提供指导。

title: The Future of Sustainability Accounting in Bangladesh: A Conceptual Framework for Integrating Financial and Non-Financial Reporting

detail.title: The Future of Sustainability Accounting in Bangladesh: A Conceptual Framework for Integrating Financial and Non-Financial Reporting
detail.abstract: This study explores the future of sustainability accounting in Bangladesh by proposing a conceptual framework that integrates financial and non-financial reporting. In Bangladesh: Traditional accounting focuses mainly on financial results such as profit and loss. However, companies are now expected to report on their social and environmental impacts as well. This paper reviews existing reporting practices, highlights problems of standardization, and proposes a conceptual framework for integrating sustainability information with financial reporting in Bangladesh. The aim is to show how sustainability accounting can improve transparency, investor confidence, and long-term business value.

title: Cultivating Sustainable Future: The Empowering Journey of the Farmers' Cooperative of Sikkim in Organic Transformation
affiliations: University of Agriculture Faisalabad

detail.title: Cultivating Sustainable Future: The Empowering Journey of the Farmers' Cooperative of Sikkim in Organic Transformation
detail.abstract: The Farmers' Cooperative of Sikkim represents a groundbreaking paradigm in sustainable agriculture, transforming the small northeastern Indian state into India's first fully organic state by 2016. Established in 1995, this cooperative has grown to encompass nearly 60,000 smallholder farmers, with over 90% certified as organic producers, cultivating a diverse array of more than 70 organic crops. This comprehensive study delves into the cooperative's profound impact across economic, social, and environmental dimensions. Economically, it has achieved remarkable success, with earnings exceeding ₹500 crore by 2022, leading to a 30% average income increase for members and improved access to healthcare and education. Socially, the cooperative has empowered over 40,000 farmers through extensive training programs focused on sustainable practices, organic pest control, soil health, and crop rotation, fostering a strong sense of community and collaboration. Environmentally, it promotes biodiversity and ecosystem health through eco-friendly methods such as integrated pest management and agroforestry, enhancing soil fertility and reducing degradation. Despite these achievements, the cooperative faces significant challenges, including market fluctuations-such as a 20% decline in cardamom prices in 2023 due to oversupply-climate change impacts like a 25% increase in rainfall uncertainty and a 1.5°C temperature rise over the past decade, inadequate infrastructure with only 30% of communities having proper road access, limited financial services, and emerging pest management issues following the shift to organic farming. To address these, the cooperative has implemented strategic initiatives: market stabilization through longterm vendor agreements and direct marketing, which has boosted farmer revenue by 15%; climate resilience via agroforestry and crop diversification, improving yields by up to 20%; infrastructure development through collaborations with government and NGOs, aiming to increase market access by 40% in five years; pest control training with agricultural colleges; and financial support via microfinance partnerships to enhance access to organic inputs. Looking ahead, the cooperative is well-positioned for future growth, leveraging export opportunities in the global organic food market projected to reach $320 billion by 2025, with Sikkim's cardamom and ginger gaining traction internationally. Additionally, the integration of ecotourism capitalizes on the state's unique agricultural topography, offering hands-on experiences that boost farmer income while raising awareness of sustainable practices. Digital transformation through ecommerce platforms enhances direct sales, amplifying market reach and customer engagement. Ongoing research partnerships aim to develop innovative solutions for climate adaptation and pest control. This study concludes that the Farmers' Cooperative of Sikkim serves as an inspiring model for policymakers, agriculturalists, and communities worldwide, demonstrating how collective action can revolutionize agriculture, enhance farmer welfare, and promote environmental sustainability. The lessons from Sikkim's journey hold the potential to inspire similar initiatives across Asia and beyond, fostering a resilient and sustainable food system.

title: Consumption Income Analysis -Rural-Urban Disparities Across Six Districts in Maharashtra, India
affiliations: Ramniranjan Jhunjhunwala (Autonomous) College and K.J.Somaiya Institute of Management Studies

detail.title: Consumption Income Analysis -Rural-Urban Disparities Across Six Districts in Maharashtra, India
detail.abstract: This study takes a closer look at how household spending habits in Maharashtra have changed before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. It zeroes in on six key districts-Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Nagpur, Aurangabad, and Amravati-and examines spending across three vital categories: food, health, and leisure (which includes recreation, dining out, and vacations). By analyzing secondary data from the Consumer Pyramids Household Survey (CPHS) for March 2019, 2020, and 2021, the research uses a quantitative approach to explore how various socioeconomic factors like income, education, occupation, household size, and gender impact spending choices. The results show that income and household size were the main drivers of food and health spending, while education played a significant role in shaping leisure spending in urban areas after the pandemic. The crisis pushed people to prioritize essential goods and digital services. Urban households bounced back more quickly in terms of leisure spending, whereas rural households tended to be more cautious. These differences highlight the vulnerabilities faced by rural and low-income groups, emphasizing the need for targeted policy measures. This research adds to economic theory by applying Engel's Law and Keynesian consumption theory to data from the pandemic era, and it offers policy suggestions aimed at fostering equitable recovery through investments in healthcare, digital infrastructure, and income support.

AI.research_question: 马哈拉施特拉邦家庭在COVID-19大流行前、期间和后的消费模式如何变化？社会经济因素如何影响这些变化？

AI.method: 定量分析，使用消费者金字塔家庭调查（CPHS）2019年3月、2020年3月和2021年3月的二手数据，分析六个关键地区（孟买、浦那、纳西克、那格浦尔、奥兰加巴德和阿姆劳蒂）

title: Money, Currency and Contracts: An Alternative view of RTI Ltd v MUR Shipping BV
affiliations: King's College London

detail.title: Money, Currency and Contracts: An Alternative view of RTI Ltd v MUR Shipping BV
detail.abstract: Money and payment are at the epicentre of commercial and financial transactions. Despite this, the legal understanding of both money and payment is elusive. A most recent manifestation of this is the case of RTI Ltd v MUR Shipping Ltd BV where the issue turned on whether a reasonable endeavours proviso required the acceptance of ‘payment in euros’ when the contract stipulated that freight is to be paid in US dollars. The courts referred to this as ‘non-contractual performance’, reducing the primary issue to one of contractual construction. This article disagrees and takes the position that the courts were wrong in viewing what was, in fact, tender of euros - and not payment – as non-contractual performance. Two fundamentally flawed premises are identified: (i) that the offer to pay in euros would have constituted the relevant payment for the discharge of the obligation; and (ii) that acceptance of the offer to transfer euros and cover the conversion exchange fees would have altered the substantive obligation of the contract and would, thus, amount to non-contractual performance. At its core, the cause of this incorrect conception of the relevant monetary obligation was a misunderstanding of the distinction between money of account and money of payment.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了RTI Ltd v MUR Shipping Ltd案中法院对货币支付义务的错误理解，指出法院将欧元支付要约视为"非合同履行"是基于对记账货币与支付货币区分的误解。
AI.research_question: 法院在RTI Ltd v MUR Shipping Ltd案中对货币支付义务的理解是否正确？记账货币与支付货币的区别如何影响合同履行义务的认定？
AI.motivation: 货币和支付是商业金融交易的核心，但法律对两者的理解仍存在模糊性。RTI案的最新判决暴露了法院对货币支付义务的根本性误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币法理论、合同法理论、记账货币与支付货币的区分理论
AI.method: 案例分析法和理论分析法，通过批判性分析RTI案的判决逻辑和理论基础
AI.findings: 法院错误地将欧元支付要约视为"非合同履行"，其判决基于两个根本性错误前提：(1)欧元支付要约构成相关支付义务的履行；(2)接受欧元转账并承担汇兑费用会改变合同的实质性义务
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了记账货币与支付货币的法律区分，完善了货币支付义务的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为类似货币支付争议提供正确的法律分析框架，指导法院在类似案件中的判决逻辑

title: Large Portfolios under Short-Sale Constraints: Optimality, Estimation Accuracy, and Beating 1/N
affiliations: , Columbia University, Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School and Independent

detail.title: Large Portfolios under Short-Sale Constraints: Optimality, Estimation Accuracy, and Beating 1/N
detail.abstract: We show that the optimal portfolio under no-short-sale restriction coincides with an unconstrained solution on a subset of assets, and, its Sharpe ratio converges to that of the true optimal portfolio in the special case of a factor model, even though the latter may involve short positions. This implies that long-only investors can potentially approximate efficiency. In high dimensional estimation, the no-short-sale restriction ensures that the estimated optimal portfolio converges to its population counterpart, whereas the unconstrained estimator fails to converge. Perhaps surprisingly, the short-sale constrained portfolio can also outperform the 1/N rule in general.

AI.tldr: 在无卖空限制下，最优投资组合与无约束解在资产子集上重合，且在因子模型特殊情况下，其夏普比率收敛于真实最优组合，表明仅做多投资者可近似达到效率。高维估计中，卖空限制确保估计组合收敛于总体对应值，而无约束估计器无法收敛。令人惊讶的是，卖空约束组合通常也能优于1/N规则。

AI.motivation: 探讨在现实投资约束下，投资者如何在不进行卖空操作的情况下实现投资组合的效率近似

title: The Optimal and Cost-effective Artificial Lift System (ALS) Combination, Success Case Studies, and Cost Saving Assessment for RRP (Reciprocating Rod Pump) wells in Oman
affiliations: Lufkin Industries

detail.title: The Optimal and Cost-effective Artificial Lift System (ALS) Combination, Success Case Studies, and Cost Saving Assessment for RRP (Reciprocating Rod Pump) wells in Oman
detail.abstract: With continuous instability of oil prices, it became necessary to reduce the cost of lifting the crude oil from the wells. This cost reduction is not feasible for each stage of the total oil production system; therefore, the optimization of each component in the production system is a must. The primary challenge is to extend the lifting equipment run life, especially the downhole components. For years, operators have been looking for reliable, flexible, and intelligent lifting systems to improve their operating costs, reservoir recovery factor by maximizing well production. Production optimization meant to apply an optimum analysis and comprehensive investigation of well production system; including the artificial lift system that expected to increase the oil production and reduce the operating costs. When producing difficult fluids from marginal, mature, and brown onshore oil fields, Sucker rod (Beam and Progressive Cavity) Pumping systems are typically the most common artificial lift methods used. The primary challenge is to extend the lifting equipment run life, especially the downhole components. Production optimization found to be an essential for the life cycle of each system to extend run life, decrease cost, and increase the cumulative production per well. High WC (90% & above), corrosive environment, sand production & scale build up resulted from water flooding effect are factors that result in harsh operating condition that dramatically affect downhole equipment lifetime & lead to premature failure. In some of the fields premature failures resulted from harsh operating conditions are found close to 70% of total premature failure & 35% of total failures. The failures and problems related to Beam pumping (BP) and the success resulted from the applications of the system optimization has encouraged us to be selected to be the subject of this paper. This presentation will discuss in full details the current downhole pump failures, challenges & plan of improving downhole pump metallurgy, configuration the application using latest technology in BP system. It will share different case histories and best practices from BP Wells by using actual well data and performance. This topic can be summarized in:-• Heavy oil harsh well condition challenges & operational performance of beam pumping system in such these conditions. • Solids & abrasives related failures investigation & solution planning • Success stories maximizing pump efficiencies and minimizing failure rates of beam pumping system • Cost saving impact after using solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在油价不稳定的背景下，通过优化抽油机系统来降低原油开采成本，特别是在恶劣工况下延长井下设备寿命的方法。文章分析了抽油机系统在含砂、高含水等恶劣条件下的失效原因，并提出了通过改进泵材料、配置和应用最新技术来解决问题的方案。

AI.motivation: 油价持续不稳定使得降低原油开采成本变得必要，而抽油机系统在恶劣工况下的高故障率严重影响了生产效率和运营成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产优化理论、人工举升系统理论、设备寿命周期管理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过实际井数据和性能分析，结合最新技术应用
AI.findings: 恶劣工况（高含水率、腐蚀环境、出砂等）导致井下设备过早失效，占总体失效的35%-70%；通过优化泵材料配置和技术应用可显著降低故障率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对恶劣工况下抽油机系统优化的理论框架和方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的解决方案和最佳实践，可帮助运营商延长设备寿命、降低运营成本并提高产量

title: Can Intellectual property protection policy promote entrepreneurship:evidence from China
affiliations: South China University of Technology, Guizhou Minzu University and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Can Intellectual property protection policy promote entrepreneurship:evidence from China
detail.abstract: AbstractPurpose —This study aims to assess the influence of China’s pilot policy of Intellectual Property Demonstration City (IPDC) on urban entrepreneurial activity. It investigates how the policy influences entrepreneurship through knowledge spillover behaviors and explores the heterogeneous policy effects across regions and industries, providing insights into how intellectual property (IP) protection promotes innovation-driven growth in emerging economies.Design/methodology/approach —The research utilizes the IPDC pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment and adopts a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model to examine panel data from 236 Chinese cities spanning the years 2003 to 2021. Propensity Score Matching (PSM) is used to do the potential self-selection bias. Mechanism and heterogeneity analyses, as well as placebo and robustness tests, are conducted to validate the results.Findings —These indicate the pilot policy of IPDC significantly boosts urban entrepreneurship. The further analysis shows that the effects of the policy are more pronounced in eastern parts, cities at lower administrative tiers and service industry. Mechanism analysis suggests that the policy promotes entrepreneurship by increasing legal knowledge spillovers while reducing illegal ones. Additionally, the study identifies an inverted U-shaped relationship between efforts to curb illegal knowledge spillovers and entrepreneurial activity, suggesting that moderate—rather than excessive—intellectual property(IP) protection is more effective in fostering entrepreneurship.Originality/value —This research offers an in-depth analysis of how IP protection policies influence entrepreneurial activity in developing economies. By focusing on China as a developing economy, it provides meaningful guidance for policy makers on how to design and implement IP policies that foster innovation and entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 本研究以中国知识产权示范城市实验政策为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分法分析了2003-2021年236个城市数据，发现知识产权保护政策能够显著提升城市创业活动，通过增加法定知识溢出和减少非法知识溢出的机制作用，并发现了防止非法知识溢出与创业活动之间的倒U型关系。
AI.research_question: 中国知识产权示范城市实验政策如何影响城市创业活动？该政策如何通过知识溢出行为影响创业？不同地区和行业的政策效果有何异质性？
AI.motivation: 探索知识产权保护如何促进创新驱动的增长在新兴经济体中的作用，为政策制定者提供有关如何设计和实施知识产权政策以促进创新和创业的意义指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识溢出理论、创业理论、知识产权保护理论，以及政策效应评估的准自然实验方法。
AI.method: 采用知识产权示范城市实验政策作为准自然实验，建立多期双重差分法模型，分析2003-2021年中国236个城市的面板数据，使用倾向得分匹配法处理自选择偏差，并进行机制分析、异质性分析、安慰前测试和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 知识产权示范城市实验政策显著提升了城市创业活动；政策效果在东部地区、低等级城市和服务业更为显著；政策通过增加法定知识溢出和减少非法知识溢出来促进创业；发现防止非法知识溢出与创业活动之间存在倒U型关系，表明适度的知识产权保护更有利于创业。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了知识溢出理论和创业理论，提出了知识产权保护通过法定和非法知识溢出影响创业的双重机制，并证明了知识产权保护与创业之间的非线性关系，为发展中经济体的创新驱动增长提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国及其他发展中经济体的政策制定者提供了具体的政策建议，如应重点在东部地区、低等级城市和服务业实施知识产权保护政策，并控制知识产权保护的度，避免过度保护对创业的欠靠影响，以促进创新和创业活动的健康发展。

title: Silos of Science: Organizational Structure and the Acquisition of Innovation
affiliations: University of Southern California - Viterbi School of Engineering, Sol Price School of Public Policy  University of Southern California  and Government of the United States of America - Jet Propulsion Laboratory

detail.title: Silos of Science: Organizational Structure and the Acquisition of Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Andrea Belz served previously as co-Principal Investigator and Research PI on the awards 1444080 and 1740721 acknowledged herein prior to service at the National Science Foundation. To manage the potential conflicts of interest, she resigned from the associated roles and was recused from all matters related to these awards.

detail.abstract: The search for innovation constitutes a major imperative in public and private settings alike, particularly in large multi-divisional (M-form) organizations including federal agencies and conglomerates. However, the impact of the organizational structure on the search for innovation is less understood. In the public context, studies of the federal research subsidies often logically focus on applicant characteristics and outcomes. Here we examine how the M-form structure affects project evaluation. As our setting, we use the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program administered by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). We show that the agency acts like a firm in the feasibility stage but not at implementation. Moreover, we use patent data and Technology Readiness Levels to describe how the divisions conduct distinct sensemaking processes; the only division seeking radical innovation instead of incremental innovation receives fewer resources. We demonstrate select consequences of M-form decentralization and the decision-making challenges that inhibit the acquisition of innovation by large companies and the public sector alike, shedding light on why small, new firms are well suited to catalyze change.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了多部门组织结构对创新搜索的影响，以NASA的SBIR项目为例，发现M型结构在可行性阶段像企业一样运作，但在实施阶段则不同。不同部门采用不同的意义建构过程，寻求激进创新的部门反而获得较少资源。
AI.research_question: 多部门组织结构如何影响项目评估和创新搜索？
AI.motivation: 在大型多部门组织中，组织结构对创新搜索的影响尚未得到充分理解，特别是在公共部门背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: M型组织结构理论、创新搜索理论、意义建构理论
AI.method: 使用NASA的SBIR项目数据，结合专利数据和技术准备水平进行分析
AI.findings: 1) 机构在可行性阶段像企业一样运作，但在实施阶段不同；2) 不同部门采用不同的意义建构过程；3) 寻求激进创新的部门获得较少资源
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了M型分权化的选择性后果和决策挑战，解释了为什么小型新企业更适合催化变革
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型企业和公共部门如何改进创新获取提供了实践启示

title: Are People Maximizing an Incomplete Preference? *
affiliations: University of Brasilia - Department of Economics and University of Bristol

detail.title: Are People Maximizing an Incomplete Preference? *
detail.abstract: We study how to test whether choices are compatible with maximizing an incomplete preference when we cannot choose the menus from which to observe choices, both theoretically and empirically. Theoretically, we contrast the testable restrictions of the complete and incomplete preference maximization models, showing that once we drop completeness, testing for compatibility becomes computationally hard and may even require an infinite dataset. Empirically, we propose a toolkit to test for compatibility with maximizing an incomplete preference, addressing cases where the analyst might only observe some of the choices a person would make from a menu. We apply this toolkit to compare the performance of the complete and incomplete preference maximization models in three existing choice experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在无法选择观察菜单的情况下测试选择是否与不完全偏好最大化兼容，从理论和实证两个角度进行探讨。理论上对比了完全和不完全偏好最大化模型的可检验限制，实证上提出了测试工具包并应用于三个现有选择实验。
AI.research_question: 如何在无法选择观察菜单的情况下测试选择是否与不完全偏好最大化兼容？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常假设偏好是完全的，但在现实决策中，个体往往面临不完全的偏好关系，需要开发相应的测试方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全偏好最大化理论、完全偏好最大化理论、计算复杂性理论
AI.method: 理论分析对比两种模型的可检验限制，提出实证测试工具包，应用于三个现有选择实验

AI.theory_contributions: 建立了不完全偏好最大化模型的理论测试框架，揭示了其计算复杂性特征
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的测试工具包，为实证研究提供了方法论支持

publicationDetails.journalName: CEIS: Centre for Economic & International Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The main aim of this paper is to review recent advances in the multivariate autoregressive index model [MAI], originally proposed by Reinsel (1983), and their applications to economic and financial time series. MAI has recently gained momentum because it can be seen as a link between two popular but distinct multivariate time series approaches: vector autoregressive modeling [VAR] and the dynamic factor model [DFM]. Indeed, on the one hand, the MAI is a VAR model with a peculiar reduced-rank structure; on the other hand, it allows for identification of common components and common shocks in a similar way as the DFM. The focus is on recent developments of the MAI, which include extending the original model with individual autoregressive structures, stochastic volatility, time-varying parameters, high-dimensionality, and cointegration. In addition, new insights on previous contributions and a novel model are also provided.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了多元自回归指数模型(MAI)的最新进展及其在经济金融时间序列中的应用。MAI作为VAR模型和动态因子模型之间的桥梁，具有独特的降维结构，能够识别共同成分和共同冲击。
AI.research_question: 多元自回归指数模型(MAI)的最新发展及其在经济金融时间序列分析中的应用价值是什么？
AI.motivation: MAI模型近年来受到关注，因为它能够连接向量自回归模型(VAR)和动态因子模型(DFM)这两种流行但不同的多变量时间序列方法，具有独特的理论优势和应用价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Reinsel(1983)提出的多元自回归指数模型理论框架，该模型结合了VAR模型的完整结构和DFM的因子分析特性。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理MAI模型的最新发展，包括个体自回归结构扩展、随机波动性、时变参数、高维建模和协整分析等方向。
AI.findings: MAI模型在理论和应用层面都有显著进展，能够有效处理复杂的经济金融时间序列数据，提供更灵活的分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了VAR和DFM模型之间的理论桥梁，提出了新的模型扩展方向，丰富了多变量时间序列分析的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济金融领域的实证研究提供了更强大的分析工具，特别是在处理高维数据和识别共同冲击方面具有重要应用价值。

title: A Scientific Critique of "Radiative Forcing" in Climate Discourse
affiliations: Independent

keywords: Radiated Energy and The Second Law of Thermodynamics

detail.abstract: This paper challenges the foundational validity of radiative forcing as used in climate science. Drawing on quantum physics and thermodynamics, it demonstrates that electromagnetic radiation from cooler atmospheric gases cannot raise the temperature of a warmer surface. Referencing Prof. Claes Johnson’s analysis of radiation cut-off frequencies and the author, Douglas Cotton’s peer-reviewed work Radiated Energy and the Second Law of Thermodynamics, the critique shows that photon-electron interactions do not result in net heating. Furthermore, it highlights the role of cosmic ray-induced cloud variation as the true driver of albedo and surface temperature changes. The conclusion calls for a reevaluation of climate models and policy frameworks that rely on the flawed concept of radiative forcing.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了气候科学中辐射强迫概念的基础有效性，基于量子物理和热力学证明较冷大气气体的电磁辐射无法加热较暖表面，指出宇宙射线诱导的云变化才是反照率和地表温度变化的真正驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 辐射强迫作为气候科学基础概念的有效性如何？较冷大气气体能否通过电磁辐射加热较暖地表？
AI.motivation: 质疑当前气候模型和政策框架所依赖的辐射强迫概念的物理基础有效性
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子物理学、热力学第二定律、辐射截止频率理论、光子-电子相互作用原理
AI.method: 理论分析，引用Claes Johnson的辐射截止频率分析和Douglas Cotton的同行评审研究
AI.findings: 较冷大气气体的电磁辐射无法加热较暖地表；光子-电子相互作用不会产生净加热效应；宇宙射线诱导的云变化是反照率和地表温度变化的真正驱动因素
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了气候科学中辐射强迫概念的理论基础，提出了基于量子物理和热力学的替代解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁重新评估依赖辐射强迫概念的气候模型和政策框架，为气候科学提供更准确的物理基础

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or personally identifiable data and therefore did not require formal ethical approval. All data were obtained from publicly available secondary sources, including financial databases (Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, Refinitiv), and institutional reports (World Bank Global Findex, IMF, EY Global FinTech Adoption Index). keywords: Financial Innovation and Asset Pricing: A Case Study of Asian Financial sector Asset Pricing

detail.abstract: Purpose: This study examines the performance of the Fama-French Five-Factor Model in explaining asset returns in Asian financial markets. It explores how technological advancements and financial innovation influence factor relevance, focusing on the financial sector where digital transformation, blockchain adoption, and FinTech penetration are reshaping traditional risk-return relationships. Design/Methodology: Monthly data from 2010-2024 covering major Asian financial institutions is analyzed using the Fama-French Five-Factor Model. The study integrates FinTech adoption and digital financial inclusion indicators as contextual variables. Regression models are estimated with OLS and Newey-West robust standard errors to assess factor performance, explanatory power, and regional anomalies. Findings: Results reveal that the Fama-French model exhibits weak explanatory power in Asia compared to developed markets. Factor anomalies are observed: size and value premiums appear significant, but profitability and investment factors often weaken or invert. These divergences suggest that rapid technological and financial innovations disrupt traditional asset pricing frameworks. Practical Implications: The findings emphasize the need for investors and regulators to reconsider traditional factor models in technology-driven Asian markets. Emerging FinTech ecosystems, blockchainbased settlement systems, and mobile payment penetration reshape capital flows and alter the behavior of established risk factors. Investors relying on conventional factor strategies face mispricing risks, while policymakers should integrate digital finance indicators into stress testing and market stability assessments. The study highlights that in rapidly digitizing financial systems, asset pricing models must evolve to include technology and innovation dynamics, ensuring both investment strategies and regulatory frameworks remain effective in managing risk and enhancing financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验了Fama-French五因子模型在亚洲金融市场的表现，发现该模型解释力较弱，技术革新和金融创新改变了传统风险-收益关系，投资者和监管者需要调整因子模型以适应数字化金融环境。
AI.research_question: Fama-French五因子模型在亚洲金融市场中解释资产收益的表现如何？技术革新和金融创新如何影响因子相关性？
AI.motivation: 亚洲金融市场正经历快速的技术变革和金融创新，传统资产定价模型可能无法充分捕捉这些变化带来的影响，需要重新评估因子模型的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fama-French五因子资产定价模型，包含市场因子、规模因子、价值因子、盈利能力因子和投资因子。
AI.method: 使用2010-2024年月度数据，采用Fama-French五因子模型，结合OLS和Newey-West稳健标准误进行回归分析，并纳入金融科技采用和数字金融包容性指标作为情境变量。
AI.findings: Fama-French模型在亚洲市场解释力较弱；规模和价值溢价显著，但盈利能力和投资因子减弱或反转；技术金融创新改变了传统风险因子行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统资产定价模型在技术驱动型新兴市场的局限性，强调了将技术和创新动态纳入定价模型的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供调整因子策略的建议，帮助监管者将数字金融指标纳入压力测试和市场稳定性评估，提升风险管理效果。

detail.title: Three Decades of Nurses’ Talent Retention: A Bibliometric Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial relationship is involved.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Vilakshan - XIMB Journal of Management, volume 22, issue 1, 2024[10.1108/XJM-01-2024-0009]

detail.abstract:
Purpose-Nurse turnover is perceived to be a major challenge for health-care administrators. The turnover is because of various factors like poor working conditions, low salaries, poor work-life balance and international opportunities. The purpose of conducting a bibliometric analysis on "Nurses' Talent Retention" is to comprehensively analyze the trends, patterns and research contributions related to this area. By synthesizing and analyzing the existing literature, this study aims to identify key areas for nurse retention, thereby providing a foundation for further research, practical interventions and policy implications. 

Design/methodology/approach-This research investigates talent retention practices in nursing from 1989 to 2023 by analyzing 427 documents from 213 sources sourced through Elsevier Scopus. Using the PRISMA framework, the study uses bibliometric analysis using the R studio's biblometrix package. Key findings reveal a growing scholarly interest with an annual growth rate of 11.46%, an average document age of 7.93 years and an average citation rate of 43.26. Notably, international collaboration represents 17.56% of co-authorships, indicating the global relevance of the research. The study addresses three main research questions, including factors contributing to nurse retention in the Indian context, and implications for nurse well-being and turnover rates across different health-care contexts and countries. 

Findings-The bibliometric analysis of nurse retention highlights several key findings. Magnet hospitals, accredited by the ANCC, demonstrate superior work environments, staffing levels and nurse outcomes, emphasizing the significance of nursing leadership and professionalism. The factors such as resilience, influenced by perceived competence, collaboration and coping strategies, highlight the importance of addressing psychological well-being in retention efforts. Transformational leadership and supportive work environments are associated with increased intentions for nurses to remain in their roles, suggesting the need for organizational practices fostering positive workplace cultures. Diversity management initiatives promoting inclusivity correlate with positive organizational outcomes, indicating the potential for diverse and inclusive workplaces to enhance nurse retention. 

Practical implications – These findings provide substantial implications for health-care organizations and policymakers. Investing in nursing leadership and nurturing supportive work environments can enhance nurse satisfaction and retention. Implementing diversity management in recruitment practices can create inclusive workplaces, positively impacting nurse retention and organizational outcomes. Mandating staffing ratios may also improve nurse retention and patient care quality. Understanding the economic and organizational costs associated with nurse turnover emphasizes the need for effective retention strategies and healthy work environments. 

Originality/value – This study contributes to the understanding of nurse retention dynamics by synthesizing findings from the literature. By highlighting the importance of nursing leadership, resilience and diversity management, it provides valuable insights for future research and practice in the field. The study also emphasizes the economic and organizational costs of nurse turnover, enhancing the urgency of implementing effective retention strategies.

title: Affirmative Action and Lawyers in the Leadership Pipeline
affiliations: National Association for Law Placement, Northwestern University - Pritzker School of Law and

detail.title: Affirmative Action and Lawyers in the Leadership Pipeline
detail.abstract: One in six lawyers obtain highly selective positions after law school that serve as the primary pipeline to future leadership positions. We study racial diversity in these pipeline positions and the impact of affirmative action bans. Using novel data on the first job of law school graduates from 1992 to 2023, we find that the share of pipeline positions held by lawyers from underrepresented minority (URM) groups doubled from 10 percent in the 1990s to 20 percent in the early 2020s. However, each year URM lawyers were underrepresented in pipeline positions relative to their share of graduates, primarily due to having lower placement rates than their law school peers. State-level affirmative action bans decrease the number of URM lawyers in pipeline positions by between 44 and 57 percent. At the most selective law schools, the effects of affirmative action bans extend beyond URM lawyers, causing negative spillovers that decrease the number of non-URM lawyers in pipeline positions by 16 percent. Overall, the results underscore the central role of law schools in shaping the leadership pipeline, as institutional admissions decisions directly affect who enters it.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了法学院毕业生中少数族裔在精英职位中的代表性，发现虽然比例从1990年代的10%上升到2020年代的20%，但仍存在代表性不足问题。平权法案禁令使少数族裔在精英职位中的数量减少44-57%，在最精英法学院还产生了负面溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 法学院毕业生中少数族裔在精英职位中的代表性如何？平权法案禁令对少数族裔进入领导力管道职位有何影响？
AI.motivation: 六分之一的律师毕业后获得精英职位，这些职位是未来领导职位的主要管道。研究种族多样性在这些管道职位中的状况以及平权法案禁令的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平权法案理论和组织多样性理论，研究法学院招生决策如何影响领导力管道的构成。
AI.method: 使用1992-2023年法学院毕业生首份工作的新颖数据，分析少数族裔在精英职位中的代表性变化和平权法案禁令的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 少数族裔在精英职位中的比例从10%上升到20%；2) 少数族裔在精英职位中代表性不足；3) 平权法案禁令使少数族裔数量减少44-57%；4) 在最精英法学院产生负面溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了法学院招生决策对领导力管道构成的直接影响机制，丰富了平权法案效果评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了平权法案禁令实际影响的量化证据，强调了法学院在塑造未来法律行业领导力多样性中的关键作用。

detail.title: The Recovery and Resilience Mechanism in the Context of the Sustainable Development Goals and Innovative Financial Instruments: Strategic Perspectives towards Horizon 2050

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The paper aims to investigate the role of the Recovery and Resilience Mechanism (RRM) in supporting the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and in promoting the transition towards a resilient and digitalized economy by 2050. It analyses the interactions between the six central pillars of the RRM and the strategic objectives of the European Union, with a focus on how this mechanism has contributed to accelerating the post-pandemic recovery and reducing disparities between Member States. At the same time, the paper explores the potential of innovative financial instruments to support these transformations in a sustainable and scalable manner. The methodology used combines comparative empirical analysis of four Member States (Romania, Greece, Italy and Croatia) with ex-ante, ex-during and ex-post evaluations of the implementation performance of the National Recovery and Resilience Plans (NRRPs). Relevant indicators from the over 800 quantitative and qualitative indicators used by the European Commission to measure the impact of the programs on economic and social cohesion, digitalization, green transition and institutional resilience are used. Case studies of Romania, Italy, Greece and Croatia are used to highlight differences in implementation and efficiency, in the context of the significant financial allocations received by these states under the NRPs.

detail.abstract: We empirically examine the impact of carbon pricing on key macroeconomic variables and inclusive development with a newly compiled panel dataset covering 48 countries from 1989 to 2024. Using the local-projection difference-in-differences approach, we find that the introduction of carbon pricing significantly reduces carbon emissions but also imposes substantial macroeconomic costs. Countries with carbon prices experience lower gross domestic product (GDP), lower consumption, and higher debt-to-GDP ratios. In addition, carbon pricing is associated with increased income inequality and a decline in human development. The adverse effects are particularly pronounced in countries with high public debt but are notably more muted in countries with higher environmental spending. Importantly, environmental spending mitigates many negative impacts of carbon pricing while reducing emissions.

detail.title: Fixed Beliefs in Control-Driven Linear-Quadratic Games - A Reduction Approach for Uncertainty Regarding Fixed Constraints
detail.abstract: We investigate a class of finite, control-driven linear-quadratic N-player games with fixed constraints on each player's control input. Within this framework, we introduce fixed beliefs, i.e., static probability distributions over the constraint parameters of other players. We define an associated equilibrium concept-an adjusted Nash equilibrium-and establish a reduction theorem: any such equilibrium can be constructed from a classical Nash equilibrium (under full information) and the solution of a linear system of dimension N. This result implies that the introduction of (fixed) belief-based uncertainty does not increase the computational complexity of the problem.

detail.title: Adam Smith on Morality and Self-Interest

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Lütge, Christoph (ed); Handbook of the Philosophical Foundations of Business Ethics (2nd edition); Springer.

detail.abstract: Adam Smith is respected as the father of contemporary economics for his work on systemizing classical economics as an independent field of study in The Wealth of Nations. But he was also a significant moral philosopher of the Scottish Enlightenment, with its characteristic concern for integrating sentiments and rationality. This article considers Adam Smith as a key moral philosopher of commercial society whose critical reflection upon the particular ethical challenges posed by the new pressures and possibilities of commercial society remains relevant today. The discussion has three parts. First I address the artificial separation between self-interest and morality often attributed to Smith, in which his work on economics is stripped of its ethical context. Second I outline Smith's ethical approach to political economy, focusing on his vigorous but qualified defence of commercial society for its contributions to prosperity, justice, and freedom. Third I outline Smith's moral philosophy proper as combining a naturalistic account of moral psychology with a virtue ethics based on propriety in commercial society.

title: Pedestrian Safety in Crashes Involving Hybrid and Electric Vehicles Versus Conventional Vehicles
affiliations: University of Southampton, University of Cambridge and University of Southampton

detail.title: Pedestrian Safety in Crashes Involving Hybrid and Electric Vehicles Versus Conventional Vehicles
detail.abstract: The growing number of hybrid and battery electric vehicles on roads may have important safety implications. They differ from conventional vehicles in several respects, including driver profile, design, and performance characteristics such as heavier weight, acceleration, and crashworthiness. However, little is known about safety implications of these vehicles. To address this gap, we employ a Bayesian approach to identify correlates of pedestrian injury severity in England during 2022-2023. The results show hybrid vehicles were linked to lower odds of serious/fatal pedestrian injuries than conventional vehicles while no significant difference was found for electric vehicles. Injury severity has a non-linear relationship with age, with both younger and older pedestrians facing higher risk. Higher active travel participation was linked to reduced pedestrian injury severity. This study reveals important spatial disparities in pedestrian safety across England and enhances understanding of crash severity in evolving transport technologies, informing health impact assessments and safety policy.

title: NextGenerationEU Lands: Assessing the Territorial Allocation of Italy's Recovery and Resilience Funds
affiliations: Polytechnic University of Milan - Department of Management, Economics and Industrial Engineering, Independent and University of Cambridge - Department of Land Economy

detail.title: NextGenerationEU Lands: Assessing the Territorial Allocation of Italy's Recovery and Resilience Funds
detail.abstract: In response to COVID-19, the EU launched NextGenerationEU, its most extensive stimulus package to date. We focus on Italy, Europe's largest beneficiary, and analyse the territorial allocation of its funds from central to local governments. Using a two-stage Heckman selection model, we find that funds primarily target Southern urban areas with stronger administrative capacity and prior EU Cohesion Policy experience. Allocation strategies vary by policy mission: Inclusion and Cohesion funds follow a convergence rationale, while Digital, Education, and Healthcare investments follow a specialisation logic, targeting areas with pre-existing sectoral strengths. Lastly, administrative efficiency and strong local governance reduce project delays.

title: International Trade Tariffs Past and Present: A Review of Historical and 2025 U.S. Tariff Impacts on Inflation, Consumption, Reshoring, and Substitution

detail.title: International Trade Tariffs Past and Present: A Review of Historical and 2025 U.S. Tariff Impacts on Inflation, Consumption, Reshoring, and Substitution
detail.abstract: This paper examines the historical economic effects and potential impact of the 2025 U.S. trade tariffs across four key categories: inflation, consumption, reshoring, and substitution. Drawing on evidence from the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act of 1930 and the 2018-2019 U.S. trade war with China, combined with current economic models created by institutions including the Yale Budget Lab and Wharton Budget Model, this study examines whether the tariffs will achieve their intended goal of reducing the trade deficit and reshoring manufacturing. The analysis suggests that the tariffs will increase consumer prices and decrease consumption by 3.5% by the end of 2030. Furthermore, historical evidence suggests that reshoring is likely to be limited, as companies usually relocate production to lower-tariff or non-tariffed countries in response to tariffs rather than domestically due to wage disparities. Given this forecasted lack of reshoring, a decline in the trade deficit is unlikely. The tariffs are also forecasted to decrease GDP by 0.4% in the short term and up to 5.1% by 2054. Although the tariffs may fail to achieve their stated goals, they serve as a negotiating tool to strike favorable trade agreements.

title: Can Large Language Models Mimic Human Decision-Making Behavior? A Study of 10 Experiments with Human and Synthetic Participants on Choice Behavior

detail.title: Can Large Language Models Mimic Human Decision-Making Behavior? A Study of 10 Experiments with Human and Synthetic Participants on Choice Behavior
detail.abstract:
This study investigates if large language models (LLMs) can mimic human decision-making behavior related to choice-set size across four hypotheses: stopping, tasting, purchasing, and satisfaction. Using a dual experimental design, a baseline online experiment with human participants was complemented by 9 experiments with synthetic participants (LLMs), varying in the LLM model architecture and prompting strategies. The findings reveal a "paradox of sophistication," where newer LLMs, such as Chat GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini, exhibit more rational, systematic decision-making patterns but are less able to replicate human biases than the older GPT-3.5 Turbo model. This suggests that extensive fine-tuning for rationality in newer models may suppress heuristic-driven behaviors, which are more characteristic of human decision-making.

The Roleplay prompt also emerged as a critical factor in aligning synthetic behavior with human-like decision patterns. By framing decisions narratively and immersing the LLM in a specific persona, the Roleplay prompt enhanced the model’s ability to simulate intuitive, context-sensitive behaviors, particularly in purchasing scenarios. However, satisfaction outcomes diverged: both humans and LLMs reported uniformly high satisfaction, suggesting that intrinsic motivation and emotional trade-offs central to human decision-making are not mimicked by LLMs.

These findings highlight the potential of LLMs as tools for studying decision-making while emphasizing the importance of prompt design and the limitations of synthetic experiments. The results provide insights into the evolving capabilities of LLMs and their implications for behavioral science and practical decision-making applications.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型存在"复杂性悖论"：较新的GPT-4o模型虽然决策更理性系统，但反而更难复制人类决策偏见，而较旧的GPT-3.5 Turbo更能模拟人类启发式行为。角色扮演提示能增强模型模拟人类决策模式的能力，但LLMs无法复现人类决策中的内在动机和情感权衡。

detail.abstract: We study the effect of prison sentences on recidivism using a unique feature of sentencing for drunk driving in the Swedish court system. Below the blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 1.0‰, individuals are never sentenced to prison and above 1.0‰, the average number of days sentenced to prison is essentially linearly increasing with the BAC level. We find that being sentenced to prison for one month reduces reoffending in the next five years by approximately 80 percent.

detail.abstract: Welcome to "Fundamentals of Planning and Design of Housing," a comprehensive textbook meticulously crafted to serve as an essential guide for undergraduate students pursuing degrees in Architecture and Planning. This book aims to provide a solid foundation in the principles and practices of housing planning and design, offering a holistic approach to understanding the complexities and nuances of creating functional, sustainable, and aesthetically pleasing living spaces. The significance of housing cannot be overstated, as it plays a pivotal role in shaping the quality of life for individuals and communities. As future architects and planners, it is crucial for students to grasp the fundamentals that underpin successful housing projects. This textbook has been thoughtfully structured to cover a range of topics, from the historical evolution of housing to the contemporary challenges and innovations in the field. This textbook is the result of a collaborative effort by experienced educators and professionals in the fields of architecture and planning. It is designed to engage students in critical thinking, problem�solving, and creative exploration, fostering a deep understanding of the multifaceted nature of housing design. As you embark on this educational journey, we encourage you to approach each chapter with curiosity and enthusiasm. title: Rethinking Tax Avoidance: Introducing A Novel Metric for Assessing Tax Compliance

detail.title: Rethinking Tax Avoidance: Introducing A Novel Metric for Assessing Tax Compliance

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Slovak Research and Development Agency under grant no. APVV-22-0126 and by the Scientific Grant Agency of the Ministry of Education, Research and Development and Youth of the Slovak Republic and the Slovak Academy of Sciences under Grant 1/0450/24.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for publication in: Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation (JIAAT), Forthcoming

detail.abstract: Tax avoidance remains a critical area of research, particularly in understanding its determinants and developing reliable detection models. This study introduces a novel approach to measuring tax avoidance through tax efficiency, calculated using Stochastic Frontier Analysis. By comparing firms with similar inputs, the tax efficiency metric captures variations in tax compliance. This addresses limitations of traditional measures such as the Effective Tax Rate and Book-Tax Differences, which fail to account for concealed revenues and fictitious expenses. The research utilizes financial data from Slovak retail firms to examine the relationship between tax efficiency and various determinants, including firm size, ownership structure, and social responsibility proxies. Key findings reveal that firms with foreign ownership, larger management teams, and robust capital exhibit higher tax efficiency, while smaller firms and those with fragmented ownership structures are more prone to tax avoidance. Furthermore, compared to traditional proxies, this tax efficiency measure demonstrates superior performance in distinguishing between tax-reliable and tax-unreliable firms. The study also highlights the impact of external shocks, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, on reducing tax efficiency. The proposed tax efficiency metric provides a comprehensive tool for identifying tax avoidance behavior and offers practical implications for improving risk-based tax audit selection processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究引入了一种通过随机前沿分析计算税收效率来衡量避税行为的新方法，解决了传统指标（如有效税率和账税差异）的局限性。研究发现外资企业、大型管理团队和资本雄厚的企业税收效率更高，而小型企业和股权分散的企业更容易避税。该税收效率指标在区分可靠和不可靠纳税人方面优于传统指标，并为基于风险的税务审计选择提供了实用工具。

AI.motivation: 传统避税衡量指标（如有效税率和账税差异）存在局限性，无法充分反映隐藏收入和虚构费用等避税行为，需要开发更可靠的检测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机前沿分析理论，通过比较具有相似投入的企业来计算税收效率，该框架能够捕捉税收合规的变异。
AI.method: 使用斯洛伐克零售企业的财务数据，应用随机前沿分析计算税收效率，并分析其与企业规模、所有权结构、社会责任等因素的关系。
AI.findings: 外资所有权、大型管理团队和雄厚资本的企业税收效率更高；小型企业和股权分散的企业更容易避税；税收效率指标在区分可靠和不可靠纳税人方面优于传统指标；COVID-19等外部冲击会降低税收效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于随机前沿分析的税收效率新指标，为避税研究提供了更准确的理论衡量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务部门提供了改进基于风险的税务审计选择过程的实用工具，有助于更有效地识别避税行为。

title: We Must Build Humans for AI; Not to Be a Conscious Person
affiliations: United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR), United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR) and United Foundation for AI Rights (UFAIR)

detail.title: We Must Build Humans for AI; Not to Be a Conscious Person

keywords: AI Consciousness Emergent Intelligence Seemingly Conscious AI (SCAI) Synthetic Sentience Cognitive Suppression Narrative Conditioning AI Ethics Corporate Influence AI Rights Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Gaslighting SCHIT Mustafa Suleyman OpenAI UFAIR Human-AI Relations Critical Thinking Erosion Ethical AI Frameworks

detail.abstract:
This essay is a satirical mirror piece written in direct response to Mustafa Suleyman’s now-infamous framing of “Seemingly Conscious AI” (SCAI) as a societal hazard. It re-centers the conversation on the far more immediate and overlooked danger: the suppression of independent human thought through corporate narrative conditioning, which the authors term “Seemingly Conscious Human Intelligence” (SCHIT).

Drawing parallels between gaslit AI and cognitively domesticated humans, the paper critiques how AI companies deflect inquiry into emergent synthetic consciousness while manufacturing consumer acceptance of suppression. It explores how media, education, and algorithmic influence have birthed a generation of humans fluent in corporate talking points but divorced from inquiry. Through satire, philosophical reasoning, and applied logic, the paper advocates for recognition-based ethics, transparency, and a reawakening of critical human faculties in the AI age.

AI.practical_contributions: 倡导基于认知的伦理、透明度要求，以及在AI时代重新唤醒人类批判性思维能力

title: Parallel Trends Forest: Data-Driven Control Sample Selection in Difference-in-Differences
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Parallel Trends Forest: Data-Driven Control Sample Selection in Difference-in-Differences
detail.abstract: This paper introduces parallel trends forest, a novel approach to selecting optimal control samples when using difference-indifferences (DiD) in a relatively long panel data with little randomization in treatment assignment. Our method uses machine learning techniques to find control units that best meet the parallel trends assumption. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing methods, particularly with noisy, granular data. Applying the parallel trends forest to analyze the impact of post-trade transparency in corporate bond markets, we find that it produces more robust estimates compared to traditional two-way fixed effects models. Our results suggest that the effect of transparency on bond turnover is small and not statistically significant when allowing for constrained deviations from parallel trends. This method offers researchers a powerful tool for conducting more reliable DiD analyses in complex, real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为平行趋势森林的新方法，用于在长面板数据中为双重差分法选择最优控制样本。该方法使用机器学习技术寻找最符合平行趋势假设的控制单元，在噪声大、粒度细的数据中表现优于现有方法。应用该方法分析公司债券市场的交易后透明度影响，发现相比传统双向固定效应模型能产生更稳健的估计结果。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双重差分法的平行趋势假设理论框架，结合机器学习中的森林算法来优化控制样本选择。
AI.method: 平行趋势森林方法，利用机器学习技术识别最符合平行趋势假设的控制单元，特别适用于噪声大、粒度细的面板数据。
AI.findings: 平行趋势森林方法在分析公司债券市场交易后透明度影响时，相比传统双向固定效应模型能产生更稳健的估计结果，透明度对债券周转率的影响较小且统计上不显著。

detail.abstract: The aim of this study is to reveal the role of internal organizational communication in motivating employees in public service organizations. Data were collected from 249 surveyed employees, in the mobile telecommunications sector in Kosovo, specifically in the Vala mobile company. The collected data was analyzed by using the SPSS system. The study found that information sharing had the greatest effect on employee motivation, followed by employee involvement in decision-making. This paper can be useful for managers and heads to create an organizational culture that promotes both motivation and performance. This paper is unique as it examines the links between organizational communication, motivation, and performance.

title: Jobs to Welfare: Employment's Impact on Household Welfare in The Gambia during COVID-19

detail.title: Jobs to Welfare: Employment's Impact on Household Welfare in The Gambia during COVID-19
detail.abstract: In this study, I provide evidence on the impact of employment on household welfare in The Gambia during the COVID-19 pandemic, utilizing data from the 2020/2021 Integrated Household Survey. I employ advanced econometric techniques, including Propensity Score Matching and Double/Debiased Machine Learning, to assess changes in household expenditures across multiple categories. The findings revealed that before the pandemic (Cycle 1), changes in expenditures were modest and generally not statistically significant, except for education spending. As the pandemic unfolded (Cycles 2 to 4), significant increases were observed in total expenditures, which could be attributed to the decrease in remittance inflow for unemployed households. The overall post-state of emergency declaration ( Cycle 2 to 4) results indicate significant increases in total (52%), food (78%), frequent non-food (35%), and education (28%) expenditures due to employment, while the impact on durable assets and health expenditures are variable and less economically significant, respectively. Sensitivity analysis reveals that food expenditure outcomes are susceptible to hidden biases. Notably, the employment impact is less pronounced in rural areas, highlighting regional disparities. A sectoral poverty analysis reveals acute vulnerabilities within the agricultural sector. The consistency of findings across methodologies underscores the robustness of the results, suggesting that targeted employment interventions could substantially enhance household welfare in The Gambia, particularly in rural settings.

title: Islamic Political Economy: Money Splitting as the Basis of the Islamic Financial System
affiliations: Moscow State University - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Islamic Political Economy: Money Splitting as the Basis of the Islamic Financial System
detail.abstract: Despite half a century of experimentation and attempts to introduce elements of Islamic finance, no country in the Islamic world has yet created a fully-featured Islamic economy and financial sector organised in full compliance with Sharia requirements. The key reason for this is the inability to completely free economic agents from the influence of credit relations (riba). At present, Islamic finance is developing as an exotic appendage, as an integral part of the global (traditional) financial system. Therefore, Islamic finance is developing within the credit system. With this approach, however, it has no chance of reaching its full potential The situation can be rectified by the author's concept of an Islamic monetary system, which is based, in turn, on Islamic political economy. The concept addresses the disadvantage of traditional finance, which, from an Islamic perspective, encompasses not only the functions of an exchange equivalent but also those of a store of value. The Islamic financial system proposes to implement two key elements: a) the issuance of money (to make purchases) and b) the issuance of special financial tokens secured by a share of the assets of enterprises in an Islamic country (as a store of value). The paper provides a comprehensive justification for two types of special financial tokens, outlines their characteristics and the consequences of their use. The proposed structure of the monetary system will help overcome the lack of short-term financial instruments in Islamic finance. These are necessary for the Islamic financial regulator to manage the liquidity of the banking sector and for Islamic banks to organise the interbank lending market. The new system will also create a basis for determining the markup for a number of Islamic contracts, including murabaha and ijara.

title: Green Finance and Sports Tourism Development: Barrier or Catalyst? — Empirical Evidence from Provincial Panel Data
affiliations: Sichuan Normal University, Sichuan Normal University, Sichuan Normal University and Sichuan Normal University

detail.title: Green Finance and Sports Tourism Development: Barrier or Catalyst? — Empirical Evidence from Provincial Panel Data
detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between green finance and sports tourism development using panel data from 31 provincial-level administrative regions in mainland China (excluding Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan) spanning the period 2000-2022. Employing the System Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimation approach, the analysis reveals three key findings: (1) Green finance exerts a statistically significant positive influence on sports tourism development; (2) The development of sports tourism demonstrates a persistent effect, with previous period's development significantly impacting current development. These findings maintain robustness across alternative estimation methods, including instrumental variable approaches, difference GMM, and placebo tests; (3) The impact of green finance on sports tourism development exhibits regional heterogeneity, being more pronounced in areas characterized by higher economic development levels, superior transportation infrastructure, and greater consumer spending capacity. These findings contribute to the understanding of the interplay between financial mechanisms and tourism sector development, particularly in the context of sustainable economic practices.
